format.name: humanart-anthropometry-summary
format.note: UTF-8 JSON, one object. 'source' names the data and its licence. 'variables' lists the measurements given a definition (id = CSV column, title and first sentence of the definition from NATICK/TR-15/007, unit). 'stats.male' and 'stats.female' map every measurement column (all 93) plus the derived ids 'bmi', 'waist_to_height', 'waist_to_hip' and 'age' to {n, mean, sd, min, p5, p50, p95, max}; lengths in mm, weightkg in kg, bmi in kg/m^2, ratios unitless, age in years. sd is the sample standard deviation (n-1). Percentiles use linear interpolation between order statistics (Hyndman-Fan type 7). 'sex_midpoint_mean' is (male mean + female mean) / 2 for every id: NOT a population statistic (see source.population_note). 'correlation' holds Pearson correlation matrices per sex over correlation.variables, row-major, 3 decimals. 'population' describes who was measured.

source.dataset: ANSUR II (2012 US Army Anthropometric Survey) public working databases
source.publisher: US Army Natick Soldier Research, Development and Engineering Center (NSRDEC); files hosted by the OPEN Design Lab, Penn State
source.report: Gordon C.C., Blackwell C.L., Bradtmiller B., Parham J.L., Barrientos P., Paquette S.P., Corner B.D., Carson J.M., Venezia J.C., Rockwell B.M., Mucher M., Kristensen S. (2014). 2012 Anthropometric Survey of U.S. Army Personnel: Methods and Summary Statistics. NATICK/TR-15/007.
source.licence: Released by the US Army for unlimited public distribution. Memorandum for Record RDNS-SEW-THA, 14 April 2017: 'These databases and this memorandum have been reviewed and cleared for UNLIMITED PUBLIC RELEASE.' Report NATICK/TR-15/007, distribution statement: 'Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.' Neither document uses the words 'public domain'; no other licence terms are attached on the hosting page.
source.population_note: US Army soldiers (Regular Army, Army Reserve, Army National Guard) measured Oct 2010 - Apr 2012; the public sample was drawn by stratified random sampling to match Army demographics of 30 Sept 2011 (TR-15/007). A working-age, physically active military population, not a general-population sample: the memorandum says it 'may or may not be representative of other populations of interest' (age and race make-up under 'population'). The memorandum warns that combining the male and female databases 'will result in a sample that is not representative of any real population'; sex_midpoint_mean is a design midpoint, not a statistic of anyone. Self-reported Heightin and Weightlbs are not used.
source.unit_fixes: weightkg divided by 10 (stored as kg*10, documented); interpupillarybreadth divided by 10 (stored in 0.1 mm, undocumented, established by comparison with the report's published percentiles)

variables.title: STATURE
variables.definition: The vertical distance from a standing surface to the top of the head is measured with an anthropometer.

variables.title: WEIGHT
variables.definition: The weight of the participant is taken to the nearest tenth of a kilogram.

variables.title: ACROMIAL HEIGHT
variables.definition: The vertical distance between a standing surface and the right acromion landmark is measured with an anthropometer.

variables.title: CERVICALE HEIGHT
variables.definition: The vertical distance between a standing surface and the cervicale landmark is measured with an anthropometer.

variables.title: SUPRASTERNALE HEIGHT
variables.definition: The vertical distance between a standing surface and the suprasternale landmark is measured with an anthropometer.

variables.title: CHEST HEIGHT
variables.definition: The vertical distance between a standing surface and the chest point anterior landmark is measured with an anthropometer.

variables.title: TENTH RIB HEIGHT
variables.definition: The vertical distance between a standing surface and the tenth rib landmark is measured with an anthropometer.

variables.title: WAIST HEIGHT (OMPHALION)
variables.definition: The vertical distance between a standing surface and the anterior omphalion landmark is measured with an anthropometer.

variables.title: ILIOCRISTALE HEIGHT
variables.definition: The vertical distance between a standing surface and the right iliocristale landmark is measured with an anthropometer.

variables.title: TROCHANTERION HEIGHT
variables.definition: The vertical distance between a standing surface and the trochanterion landmark is measured with an anthropometer.

variables.title: CROTCH HEIGHT
variables.definition: The vertical distance between the standing surface and the crotch is measured with an anthropometer.

variables.title: KNEE HEIGHT, MIDPATELLA
variables.definition: The vertical distance between a standing surface and the midpatella landmark is measured with an anthropometer.

variables.title: LATERAL FEMORAL EPICONDYLE HEIGHT
variables.definition: The vertical distance between a standing surface and the standing lateral femoral epicondyle landmark is measured with an anthropometer.

variables.title: TIBIAL HEIGHT
variables.definition: The vertical distance between a standing surface and the tibiale landmark is measured with an anthropometer.

variables.title: LATERAL MALLEOLUS HEIGHT
variables.definition: The vertical distance between a standing surface and the lateral malleolus landmark is measured with a modified height gauge.

variables.title: SITTING HEIGHT
variables.definition: The vertical distance between a sitting surface and the top of the head is measured with an anthropometer.

variables.title: SPAN
variables.definition: The distance between the tips of the middle fingers (dactylion III) of the horizontally outstretched arms is measured on a wall chart.

variables.title: ACROMION-RADIALE LENGTH
variables.definition: The distance between the right acromion landmark and the radiale landmark is measured with a beam caliper held parallel to the long axis of the arm.

variables.title: SHOULDER-ELBOW LENGTH
variables.definition: The distance between the right acromion landmark and the olecranon bottom landmark is measured with a beam caliper parallel to the long axis of the upper arm.

variables.title: RADIALE-STYLION LENGTH
variables.definition: The distance between the radiale landmark and the stylion landmark is measured with a beam caliper held parallel to the long axis of the forearm.

variables.title: FOREARM-HAND LENGTH
variables.definition: The horizontal distance between the olecranon rear landmark and the dactylion III landmark is measured with a beam caliper.

variables.title: BUTTOCK-KNEE LENGTH
variables.definition: The horizontal distance between a buttock plate placed at the most posterior point on either buttock and the knee point, anterior landmark, is measured with an anthropometer.

variables.title: BIACROMIAL BREADTH
variables.definition: The distance between the right and left acromion landmarks is measured with a beam caliper.

variables.title: BIDELTOID BREADTH
variables.definition: The maximum horizontal distance between the lateral margins of the upper arms on the deltoid muscles is measured with a beam caliper.

variables.title: CHEST BREADTH
variables.definition: The maximum horizontal breadth of the chest at the level of the chest point anterior landmark is measured with a beam caliper.

variables.title: CHEST DEPTH
variables.definition: The horizontal distance between the chest point anterior landmark and the back at the same level is measured with a beam caliper.

variables.title: WAIST BREADTH
variables.definition: The horizontal breadth of the waist at the level of omphalion is measured with a beam caliper.

variables.title: WAIST DEPTH
variables.definition: The horizontal distance between the anterior and posterior omphalion landmarks is measured with a beam caliper.

variables.title: BICRISTAL BREADTH
variables.definition: The straight-line distance between the right and left iliocristale landmarks is measured with a beam caliper.

variables.title: HIP BREADTH
variables.definition: The horizontal distance between the lateral buttock landmarks is measured with a beam caliper.

variables.title: BUTTOCK DEPTH
variables.definition: The horizontal depth of the torso at the level of the buttock point, posterior and right lateral landmarks, is measured using a beam caliper.

variables.title: CHEST CIRCUMFERENCE
variables.definition: The maximum horizontal circumference of the chest at the level of chest point, anterior is measured with a tape.

variables.title: WAIST CIRCUMFERENCE (OMPHALION)
variables.definition: The horizontal circumference of the waist, passing over all omphalion landmarks, is measured with a tape.

variables.title: BUTTOCK CIRCUMFERENCE
variables.definition: The horizontal circumference of the trunk at the level of the buttock point, posterior, right and left lateral landmarks, is measured with a tape.

variables.title: THIGH CIRCUMFERENCE
variables.definition: The circumference of the right thigh at the gluteal furrow landmark is measured with a tape.

variables.title: LOWER THIGH CIRCUMFERENCE
variables.definition: The horizontal circumference of the right thigh at the level of the suprapatella landmark is measured with a tape.

variables.title: CALF CIRCUMFERENCE
variables.definition: The maximum horizontal circumference of the right calf is measured with a tape.

variables.title: ANKLE CIRCUMFERENCE
variables.definition: The minimum horizontal circumference of the right ankle is measured with a tape.

variables.title: BICEPS CIRCUMFERENCE, FLEXED
variables.definition: The circumference of the right upper arm around the flexed biceps brachii muscle at the biceps point landmark is measured with a tape held perpendicular to the long axis of the upper arm.

variables.title: FOREARM CIRCUMFERENCE, FLEXED
variables.definition: The circumference of the flexed right forearm is measured with a tape passing across the crease at the juncture between the upper arm and the forearm.

variables.title: WRIST CIRCUMFERENCE
variables.definition: The circumference of the wrist, perpendicular to the long axis of the forearm, is measured with a tape passing over the stylion landmark.

variables.title: NECK CIRCUMFERENCE
variables.definition: The circumference of the neck at the level of the infrathyroid landmark (Adam's apple) is measured with a tape.

variables.title: NECK CIRCUMFERENCE, BASE
variables.definition: The circumference of the base of the neck is measured with a tape, passing over the drawn lateral and anterior neck landmarks.

variables.title: SHOULDER CIRCUMFERENCE
variables.definition: The circumference of the shoulders at the level of the right and left deltoid point landmarks is measured with a tape.

variables.title: ABDOMINAL EXTENSION DEPTH, SITTING
variables.definition: The horizontal distance between the abdominal point anterior and the back at the same level is measured with a beam caliper.

variables.title: HAND LENGTH
variables.definition: The length of the right hand between the stylion landmark on the wrist and the tip of the middle finger is measured with a Poech sliding caliper.

variables.title: HAND BREADTH
variables.definition: The breadth of the right hand between the landmarks at metacarpale II and metacarpale V is measured with a sliding caliper.

variables.title: PALM LENGTH
variables.definition: The distance between the center of the crease at the base of the middle finger (digit III, base) and the ventral stylion landmark is measured with a Poech sliding caliper.

variables.title: FOOT LENGTH
variables.definition: The maximum length of the right foot is measured with a Brannock Device(R).

variables.title: FOOT BREADTH, HORIZONTAL
variables.definition: The maximum breadth of the right foot is measured with a Brannock Device(R).

variables.title: HEAD CIRCUMFERENCE
variables.definition: The maximum circumference of the head above the attachment of the ears is measured with a tape passing just above the ridges of the eyebrows and around the back of the head.

variables.title: HEAD LENGTH
variables.definition: The distance from the glabella landmark to the opisthocranion landmark is measured with a spreading caliper.

variables.title: HEAD BREADTH
variables.definition: The maximum horizontal breadth of the head above the plane of attachment of the ears is measured with a spreading caliper.

variables.title: BIZYGOMATIC BREADTH
variables.definition: The maximum horizontal breadth of the face (between the zygomatic arches) at the left and right zygion landmarks is measured with a spreading caliper.

variables.title: INTERPUPILLARY BREADTH
variables.definition: The distance between the two pupils is measured with a pupillometer.

variables.title: MENTON-SELLION LENGTH
variables.definition: The distance between the menton landmark and the sellion landmark is measured with a sliding caliper.

variables.title: TRAGION - TOP OF HEAD
variables.definition: The vertical distance between the right tragion landmark and the horizontal plane tangent to the top of the head is measured with a beam caliper with a paddle blade.

variables.title: EAR LENGTH
variables.definition: The length of the right ear, from its highest to lowest points on a line parallel to the long axis of the ear, is measured with a sliding caliper.

derived.waist_to_height: waistcircumference / stature (waist at omphalion, the navel, not the WHO site midway between lowest rib and iliac crest)
